message.content: {"action": "commit", "move": "g5f4", "objective": "Keep the dark-squared bishop active on f4, and prepare kingside castling.", "rationale": "Bf4 is the only commit-ready move: reserved single-candidate verification at effective depth 4 gave exact score 55 with no mate-in-one and no tactical refutation found. It avoids the Bxd3/Bxf6 tension on g5, keeps an active bishop on f4, and does not return the piece home (unlike Bc1). Black can play Bxd3 geometrically, but that is not a proven refutation, and the engine line Bf4 Nc6 h3 keeps a small edge. g5e3 scores 53 but was not single-candidate verified, so Bf4 is chosen."}
